type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Create complete vendable repo structure for I Framework

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: FiniteStateSpace_length
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : FiniteStateSpace.length = 4

theorems_only_on_branches.name: IState_has_two_distinct_elements
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Inhabited α] : ∃ (a b : IState α), a ≠ b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: I_absorbing
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (Ts : List (Transformation α α)) (hTs : ∀ T ∈ Ts, IPropagating T) : (chainTransformations Ts) IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: I_in_FiniteStateSpace
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : IState.I ∈ FiniteStateSpace

theorems_only_on_branches.name: I_is_fixpoint_of_ipropagating
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (T : Transformation α α) (h : IPropagating T) : T IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: I_ne_known
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (x : α) : (IState.I : IState α) ≠ IState.Known x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: apply_I_propagating
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) (h : IPropagating T) : T IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: chain_nil
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} : chainTransformations ([] : List (Transformation α α)) = id

theorems_only_on_branches.name: chain_propagates
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (Ts : List (Transformation α α)) (hTs : ∀ T ∈ Ts, Propagates T) : Propagates (chainTransformations Ts)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: chain_singleton
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (T : Transformation α α) : chainTransformations [T] = meta_compose id T

theorems_only_on_branches.name: collapse_known_ne_unknown
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (P Q : Problem) (hk : Problem.isKnown P) (hu : Problem.isUnknown Q) : collapse P ≠ collapse Q

theorems_only_on_branches.name: collapse_known_not_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (P : Problem) (hk : Problem.isKnown P) : collapse P ≠ IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: collapse_op_preserves_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) : (collapse_op p) IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: collapse_unknown_is_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (P : Problem) (hu : Problem.isUnknown P) : collapse P = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: compose_id_right
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) : TransformationEq (meta_compose T id) T

theorems_only_on_branches.name: compose_propagates
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β γ : Type} (T₁ : Transformation α β) (T₂ : Transformation β γ) (h₁ : Propagates T₁) (h₂ : Propagates T₂) : Propagates (meta_compose T₁ T₂)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: consistent_compose
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β γ : Type} (T₁ : Transformation α β) (T₂ : Transformation β γ) (h₁ : Consistent T₁) (h₂ : Consistent T₂) : Consistent (meta_compose T₁ T₂)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: consistent_preserves_known
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) (hc : Consistent T) (x : α) : ∃ y : β, T (IState.Known x) = IState.Known y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: evenFilter_propagates_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : IPropagating evenFilter

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (d : α) : extractWithDefault IState.I d = d

theorems_only_on_branches.name: extract_known
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (x d : α) : extractWithDefault (IState.Known x) d = x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: global_propagation_theorem
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) (h : IPropagating T) : ∀ s : State α, s = IState.I → T s = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: global_stability
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (α β : Type) (T : ValidTransformation α β), Stable T.fn

theorems_only_on_branches.name: id_compose_left
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) : TransformationEq (meta_compose id T) T

theorems_only_on_branches.name: ipropagating_propagates
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) (h : IPropagating T) : Propagates T

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] : isIndeterminate (IState.I : State α) = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: isIndeterminate_known
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (x : α) : isIndeterminate (IState.Known x) = false

theorems_only_on_branches.name: isKnown_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] : isKnown (IState.I : State α) = false

theorems_only_on_branches.name: isKnown_known
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (x : α) : isKnown (IState.Known x) = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: known_ne_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (x : α) : IState.Known x ≠ (IState.I : IState α)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: known_ne_indeterminate
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (x : α) : IState.Known x ≠ (IState.I : IState α)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: liftTransformation_identityPreserving
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : IdentityPreserving' (liftTransformation f)

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : Stable (liftTransformation f)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: liftTransformation_propagates
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : IPropagating (liftTransformation f)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: liftTransformation_propagatesI
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : Propagates (liftTransformation f)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: liftTransformation_stable
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : Stable (liftTransformation f)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: lift_preserves_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : (fun s => match s with | IState.Known x => IState.Known (f x) | IState.Indeterminate => IState.I) IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: lift_propagates_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : Propagates (liftTransformation f)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: meta_add_I_left
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Add α] (y : IState α) : meta_add IState.I y = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: meta_add_I_right
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Add α] (x : IState α) : meta_add x IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: meta_compose_preserves_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β γ : Type} (T₁ : Transformation α β) (T₂ : Transformation β γ) (h₁ : IPropagating T₁) (h₂ : IPropagating T₂) : IPropagating (meta_compose T₁ T₂)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: meta_lift1_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (f : α → α) : meta_lift1 f IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: meta_lift2_I_left
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (f : α → α → α) (y : IState α) : meta_lift2 f IState.I y = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: meta_mul_I_left
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Mul α] (y : IState α) : meta_mul IState.I y = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: meta_mul_I_right
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Mul α] (x : IState α) : meta_mul x IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (Ts : List (Transformation α α)) (hTs : ∀ T ∈ Ts, Propagates T) (s₀ : State α) (hs₀ : IndeterminateState α s₀) : IndeterminateState α (chainTransformations Ts s₀)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: propagation_does_not_create_known
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (T : Transformation α α) (h : Propagates T) : ∀ s : State α, IndeterminateState α s → IndeterminateState α (T s)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: propagation_not_determinising
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (T : Transformation α α) (h : IPropagating T) : T IState.I ≠ IState.Known (T IState.I |>.extractVal) ∨ T IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: stable_known_not_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) (hs : Stable T) (x : α) : T (IState.Known x) ≠ IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: stable_maps_I_to_I
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) (hs : Stable T) : T IState.I = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: stable_maps_known_to_known
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) (hs : Stable T) (x : α) : ∃ y : β, T (IState.Known x) = IState.Known y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: stable_preserves_determinate
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) (hs : Stable T) : ∀ s : State α, DeterminateState s → DeterminateState (T s)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: stable_preserves_indeterminate
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : Transformation α β) (hs : Stable T) : ∀ s : State α, IndeterminateState α s → IndeterminateState β (T s)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: system_not_trivially_inconsistent
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ¬∀ (α : Type) (s : State α), s = IState.I

theorems_only_on_branches.name: system_stability_theorem
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : ValidTransformation α β) : (∀ s : State α, DeterminateState s → DeterminateState (T.fn s)) ∧ (∀ s : State α, IndeterminateState α s → IndeterminateState β (T.fn s))

theorems_only_on_branches.name: valid_compose_stable
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β γ : Type} (T₁ : ValidTransformation α β) (T₂ : ValidTransformation β γ) : Stable (meta_compose T₁.fn T₂.fn)

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type} (T : ValidTransformation α β) : Propagates T.fn
